title: Spatial Relationships and Queries — practice

objective: Apply spatial relationships and queries in a controlled MySQL workflow.

options: Skip testing, assume every SQL engine behaves identically, and apply the change directly to production.

expected_output: Join two synthetic related tables, count the result rows, and explain what happens when one side has no match.

hints: Start with the smallest repeatable example or inspection step.
